titulo: Italy to deploy 500 troops to Milan after days of protests and looting
cuerpo: Government planning tougher security measures as France also says military forces will be deployed Why are people protesting across Europe? Italy’s government is sending 500 soldiers to Milan and vowed a “firm response from the state” after protests against the cost of living descended into clashes with police, vandalism and looting. Further demonstrations are planned on Saturday. The government of the far-right prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, also announced new security measures, including an offence of violent participation in ⁠a demonstration, tougher penalties for ⁠rioters, and financial liability for ​parents whose children take part in vandalism and looting.
